title: Worthington Water Splash
subtitle: Capillary Crown Elevation & Rayleigh-Plateau Jet
description: High-speed fluid drop impact mechanics capturing the elevated crenellated Worthington splash crown, Rayleigh-Plateau capillary central jet, and pinch-off droplet ballistics.
mathNotation: r(\theta) = R_{\text{rim}} [1 + A_c \sin(n \theta)], \quad y_{\text{drop}}(t) = y_0 + v_{y0} t - \frac{1}{2} g t^2, \quad \lambda_{\text{opt}} \approx 4.51 d_{\text{jet}}
formulaCompact: crown_h = sin(age * π) * 110,  jet_h = sin(jetAge * π) * 160,  drop_y += vy*dt + 0.5*g*dt^2
